## Quarto



```{webr}
#| label: pfas-data-setup
#| autoplay: true
#| include: false #hides box completely

APP_CONFIG <- list(
  limit_mld      = 10,
  threshold_kg   = 1.0,
  theme_primary  = "#2c3e50",
  days_per_year  = 365,
  ml_to_l        = 1e6,
  m3_to_l        = 1e3, #new To add to Chris
  kg_to_g        = 1e3,
  m3_to_kg       = 1e3,
  ng_to_kg       = 1e-12,
  zero_tol       = 1e-9   # Tolerance for filtering empty mass rows
)

options(scipen = 9999)

#Treatment of Not measured and non detects
#Not measured = NA
#Below reporting detection limit = taken 1/2 of the value
below_detection_limit_factor <- 0.5

#=============
#helperFunctions
#=============

clean_pfas <- \(df) {
  df <- df |> clean_names()
  if ("pfas" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(substance_name = pfas)
  if ("substance" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(substance_name = substance)
  if ("cas" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(cas_rn = cas)
  
  df |> 
    mutate(
      across(-any_of(c("substance_name", "cas_rn")), \(val) {
        val_str <- as.character(val)
        num_val <- suppressWarnings(parse_number(val_str))
        if_else(str_starts(val_str, "<"), num_val / 2, num_val) #takes care of 0.5RDL
      }),
      across(any_of(c("substance_name", "cas_rn")), \(val) str_trim(as.character(val)))
    )
}

#=============
#import
#=============

dt_reportablePFAS<-readRDS("Table_1.rds")%>% 
  dplyr::mutate('NPRI_param' = TRUE) 
bio_spec = read_rds("Table_8.rds") |> clean_pfas()
eff_spec = read_rds("Table_7.rds") |> clean_pfas()
effUS_spec = read_rds("Table_6.rds") |> clean_pfas()

```

```{webr}
#| exercise: pfas-data
# 2. Render instantly using built-in, non-blocking bootstrap tables
knitr::kable(head(dt_reportablePFAS, n = 5), format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-striped'")
```

```{webr}
# 2. Render the interactive table bundled with browser download hooks
DT::datatable(
  head(dt_reportablePFAS, 100),               # Exporting a sample preview chunk
  extensions = 'Buttons',           # Activates the DataTables buttons library extension
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip',                 # 'B' places the action buttons at the very top
    buttons = list(
      list(
        extend = 'excel',           # Generates an open-xml excel binary package
        text = 'Download as Excel', # Text displayed on the clickable layout button
        title = 'PFAS_Data_Export'  # The default filename assigned when saved
      ),
      list(
        extend = 'csv',             # Backup option for basic comma-separated tables
        text = 'Download as CSV'
      )
    ),
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE                  # Safeguards wide data frames from leaking out
  )
)
```
